item.title: Proposed Veterans Hall of Fame would honor Marion County residents
item.description: Local leaders will consider a measure to create a new veterans' hall of fame that would honor military veterans not solely for their military service, but for their leadership, community involvement, and civic contributions specifically within Marion County. item.title: I think new coffee shops in Ocala are an indicator of urban growth.
item.description: "I respect all perspectives, but I do not view the establishment of coffee shops in various areas of the town as detrimental. I see this as an indicator of urban growth and a significant opportunity for job creation. I propose that another location near Maricamp Road would be an excellent opportunity. item.title: Final decision upcoming on historic landmark where Tom Petty met Elvis in Ocala
item.description: City officials will vote on a request from the Ocala Sunset Rotary Club to designate a historic marker commemorating the day that 10-year-old Tom Petty visited Ocala and met Elvis Presley on the set of "Follow That Dream." item.description: Norman Grenier was a man of deep faith and boundless generosity, Norm had a gift for making others laugh. He loved praying, helping those in need, riding motorcycles, and spending time with the family he treasured above all else. Read more: Norman D. Grenier
